standard.summary: Smart Caption 根据标签的语义角色（触发词、风格词、质量词、内容词、修饰词）施加不同概率的丢弃。比全局 caption_dropout_rate 更精细。
standard.effect: 六个 sc_* 默认全为 0（opt-in，不改变任何默认训练行为）。显式设置后按角色生效：例如 sc_style_dropout=0.05 时风格词很少被丢弃；sc_quality_dropout=0.3 时质量标签（如 masterpiece）经常被丢弃；sc_content_dropout=0.15 适度丢弃内容词；sc_locked_tags 列出的标签任何速率下都不丢。
standard.whenToUse: 数据有详细的结构化标注时。想精细控制不同类型标签的丢弃概率时。
standard.avoidWhen: 标注不区分语义角色时。sc_locked_tags 可以指定永不被丢弃的标签。

standard_en.summary: Smart Caption applies a different dropout probability according to a tag's semantic role (trigger word, style word, quality word, content word, modifier). Finer-grained than the global caption_dropout_rate.
standard_en.effect: All six sc_* fields default to 0 (opt-in; default training behaviour is unchanged). Once set explicitly, each role applies its own rate: e.g. sc_style_dropout=0.05 rarely drops style words; sc_quality_dropout=0.3 often drops quality tags (masterpiece and the like); sc_content_dropout=0.15 drops content words moderately; tags listed in sc_locked_tags are never dropped.
standard_en.whenToUse: When the data carries detailed structured tagging. When you want fine control over the dropout probability of each kind of tag.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When the tagging does not distinguish semantic roles. sc_locked_tags can name tags that are never dropped.

advanced.principle: 将每个 caption 的标签分类为 trigger/style/quality/content/modifier 五种角色，每种角色有独立的丢弃概率。这比全局 dropout 更好——触发词应该始终保留（确保身份绑定），而质量标签经常丢弃（让模型不依赖质量标签生成高质量图像）。
advanced.intervention: 训练建 dataset 时把六个 sc_* 速率传进 CaptionDataset；任一速率 > 0 才启用分桶 dropout，DataLoader 的 _process_caption 对分类后的标签按角色分别施加丢弃。
advanced.expectedImpact: 在多概念训练中改善触发词绑定和 prompt 灵活性。
advanced.tradeoffs: sc_locked_tags 指定不受 dropout 影响的标签列表。
advanced.codePath: configs_dataset.py sc_* → trainer_model_prep_dataset_input.py _build_caption_dataset → dataset_loader.CaptionDataset(_smart_caption) → dataset_caption_policy.py apply_layered_tag_dropout() → smart_caption.SmartCaptionProcessor

advanced_en.principle: Classifies each caption's tags into five roles — trigger/style/quality/content/modifier — each with its own drop probability. This is better than global dropout: trigger words should always be kept (to secure identity binding), while quality tags are often dropped (so the model generates high-quality images without depending on quality tags).
advanced_en.intervention: At dataset build time the six sc_* rates are passed into CaptionDataset; bucketed dropout is enabled only when any rate > 0, and the DataLoader's _process_caption applies drops per role to the classified tags.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Improves trigger binding and prompt flexibility in multi-concept training.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: sc_locked_tags specifies a tag list exempt from dropout.
advanced_en.codePath: configs_dataset.py sc_* → trainer_model_prep_dataset_input.py _build_caption_dataset → dataset_loader.CaptionDataset(_smart_caption) → dataset_caption_policy.py apply_layered_tag_dropout() → smart_caption.SmartCaptionProcessor
